theme_strategy.rationale: Real estate CRMs require prolonged viewing, heavy data entry, and reading dense tables (commissions, salaries, plots). A clean, paper-like light theme ensures minimal eye strain and maximum data legibility. Dark mode can be provided as an accessibility toggle.

headings.usage: Page titles, card headers, KPI values.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, labels, body copy.

mono.usage: Currency values (₹), plot dimensions, IDs, and financial figures.

hierarchy_rules: H1 (Page Title): text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
H2 (Section/Card Title): text-lg sm:text-xl font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-800
Data/KPI Number: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tighter
Table Header: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-slate-500
Currency: Use IBM Plex Mono for all ₹ amounts to ensure tabular alignment.

rules: NEVER use default Tailwind Blue as primary. Use Slate-900 for structure and Emerald-700 for key actions (representing land/money).
Status badges must use the semantic bg + semantic text + semantic border to be extremely clear at a glance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' and 'Crisp Edges' approach. Dashboards should be card-based with 1px border (`border-slate-200`) and minimal border-radius (`rounded-lg`).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove default heavy shadows. Use `shadow-sm` for cards, and `shadow-md` only for floating elements (dropdowns, modals, toasts).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for this CRM. Data needs solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction and maintain maximum legibility.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid `border-slate-200` everywhere. Use `divide-y divide-slate-100` in lists to separate items cleanly.

grids_layouts.global_layout: Master-Detail-Drawer or Left-Sidebar pattern. Top nav for mobile, collapsible left sidebar for desktop to maximize vertical space.
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. Gap: `gap-4` or `gap-6`.
grids_layouts.kpi_cards: `col-span-1`. Should contain Title, Value (Mono font), and a small trend line/indicator.
grids_layouts.charts: `col-span-2` or `col-span-4`. Use Recharts. Keep them clean, remove heavy gridlines (use stroke-dasharray), and use semantic colors.
grids_layouts.projects_inventory: Provide both a Table view (dense data) and a Grid view (Cards with plot images, area, and status).
grids_layouts.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Stack labels above inputs. Left-align everything.

components.charts: Use Recharts (`recharts` package). Implement Bar charts for Monthly Sales and Line charts for Collections vs Expenses.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Must have hover states on rows (`hover:bg-slate-50`). Align numeric columns (like ₹ amounts) to the right.
components.badges: Use Shadcn Badge. Customize to match Semantic colors.
components.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Admin Excel/CSV Bulk Upload preview.
components.toasts: Use Sonner (`sonner` package) for success/error notifications (e.g., 'Agent created', 'Sales entry saved').
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`). They look crisp and professional in dense dashboards. Standardize on 'regular' or 'duotone' weight.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`). Primary buttons use Emerald. Secondary use white bg with Slate border.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover for all rows, buttons, and cards (`transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out`).
motion.transitions: Use `translate-y-[-2px] shadow-md` on hover for Project Cards.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders (`animate-pulse`) for dashboard charts and tables during data fetch.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Text on colored badges must be high contrast (e.g., dark green text on light green bg).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-1`.
accessibility.aria: Add `aria-label` to icon-only buttons (like edit/delete actions).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

media.image_handling: Images of plots/projects should be `object-cover` and constrained. E.g., `h-48 w-full object-cover rounded-t-lg`. Max height 80vh for modals.
media.agent_avatars: Use circular avatars `h-10 w-10 rounded-full object-cover`.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The codebase uses `.js` and `.jsx` files, NOT `.tsx`. Do not create TypeScript files.
1. DEPENDENCIES: Install `@phosphor-icons/react`, `recharts`, `sonner`, `lucide-react` (if shadcn uses it), and `clsx`/`tailwind-merge`.
2. FONTS: Import 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'IBM Plex Mono' in the main index.css or index.html.

3. LAYOUT: Create a persistent Left Sidebar (with a collapsible hamburger menu for mobile) using a grid or flex layout. The main content area should have a subtle off-white background (`bg-slate-50`).

4. ROLE-BASED UI: Mock a login state (`userRole: 'admin' | 'agent'`). Admin sees 'Company Expenses', 'Salary', 'Admin Bulk Upload'. Agent sees only 'My Dashboard', 'Projects Inventory', 'My Sales', 'My Commissions'.
5. DASHBOARD: Build 4 KPI cards at the top. Follow with two Recharts: a BarChart for 'Monthly Sales (₹)' and a LineChart for 'Collections vs Expenses'.
6. PROJECTS: Build an Inventory page. Use a Tabs component to switch between 'Grid View' (cards with images) and 'Table View' (dense data). Add Status Badges.

7. BULK UPLOAD: In the Admin section, add a 'Bulk Upload (Excel/CSV)' button that opens a Shadcn Dialog. Inside, show a drag-and-drop area, and a mock 'Preview Table' for validation before the user clicks 'Confirm & Upload'.
8. CURRENCY: Ensure every monetary value is prefixed with the Indian Rupee symbol (₹) and formatted with commas (e.g., ₹ 12,50,000).
9. EXPORT: Add an 'Export (CSV/Excel/Print)' Button with a Phosphor Download icon on all tabular data pages (Reports, Sales, Accounts).
10. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and key metric cards have a `data-testid` attribute.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component should be located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
